violated_contract: Auth credential store functions (store_api_key, store_oauth_tokens, update_oauth_id_token, clear_credentials) and config commands perform a read-modify-write cycle on the shared TOML config file without serialization. Two concurrent calls for different profiles both load the same stale config, each mutates a different profile, then both save — the last save overwrites the first profile's changes, silently dropping its credential.
canonical_prevention: Serialize all config read-modify-write cycles with a cross-platform file lock (fcntl.flock on POSIX, msvcrt.locking on Windows) around cfg.load() -> mutate -> cfg.save().
